title: sinosenecio ligularioides
intro: Sinosenecio ligularioides, commonly known as Chinese angelica tree, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Sinosenecio ligularioides include analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, as well as the potential to regulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
